rules.description: Verify all active StatVars meet scoped freshness boundaries (2024 for refreshed series, 2022/2020 for education/vital stats, 2019 for 2019 census, and >= 2009 for 2009 historical census).

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats
params.condition: CASE WHEN StatVar IN ('Count_Student_KenyaCertificateSecondaryEducation', 'Count_Student_KenyaCertificateSecondaryEducation_Female', 'Count_Student_KenyaCertificateSecondaryEducation_Male') OR regexp_matches(StatVar, '^(Mean_AssessmentScore_Student_|Count_Student_.*AdultEducation|Count_Person_KenyaCertificatePrimaryEducation_)') THEN MaxDate >= '2022' WHEN StatVar IN ('Count_BirthEvent_LiveBirth', 'Count_MaternalMortalityEvent', 'Count_Student_PrimarySchool', 'Count_Student_SecondarySchool') THEN MaxDate >= '2020' WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, '^(Count_(Death|MortalityEvent|BirthEvent|(Student|Person)_KenyaCertificateSecondaryEducation)|(Nominal_|RealValue_|GrowthRate_)?Amount_(Economic|Expenditure)Activity_GrossDomesticProduction)') THEN MaxDate >= '2024' WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, '^(Count_Household|Area_LandCover|Count_Person($|_(Female|Male|Intersex|Urban|Rural|PerArea)))') THEN MaxDate >= '2019' ELSE MaxDate >= '2009' END AND total_svs > 0

rules.description: Checks that deleted records do not exceed threshold (0.1%).
